tip: gt sync is a core command that keeps your branches in sync with the latest changes to the remote repository. It:
▸ pulls the latest changes to the trunk branch
▸ prompts to delete any branches whose PRs have been merged or closed
▸ syncs any remote changes to branches with open PRs
▸ restacks all branches to incorporate the latest changes from trunk

You can use gt get to sync only the stack of the checked out branch. [sync.explanation ●○○]
